capabilities: Runs the Claude Code CLI in a right-sidebar terminal
Streams chat replies with tool-use pills and per-turn cost
Passes the active note, folder and selection as context
Attaches files and pasted clipboard images
Shows Claude plan and rate-limit usage
disambiguation: Not a Claude API chat client; it drives the locally installed Claude Code CLI as a subprocess.
extras: Desktop only. The terminal UI is untested on Linux and needs Python 3.8+ or the script command on macOS/Linux, or Windows PowerShell 5.1 on Windows; the chat UI avoids PowerShell. The plugin opens a loopback HTTP hook server, writes temporary scripts to the OS temp folder, and sends prompts, note paths and selections to Anthropic through the CLI. UI available in English and Japanese.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hand notes to an AI agent that can read, search and edit the vault from inside the app.

relations.evidence: It runs the claude CLI with the active vault as its working directory

requires.name: Claude Pro / Max subscription or Anthropic API key
Python 3.8 or later (macOS / Linux terminal UI)

summary: Right-sidebar panel that runs the Claude Code CLI against the vault, offering a terminal UI or a streaming chat UI.
